en.name: aPTT in blood
en.longDescription: ## Definition & Clinical Context The activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) measures the time, in seconds, required for plasma to form a clot after addition of an activator, a phospholipid emulsion, and calcium [1]. The source data will typically be a single numeric result per patient-timestamp, produced by a coagulation analyser on platelet poor plasma (PPP). Results are reported in seconds [2]. **Note: aPTT vs aPTT ratio.** The aPTT (this concept set) and the aPTT ratio are two different representations of the same underlying physical measurement, with different normalisations: - **aPTT (seconds)** — raw measurement; depends on the laboratory's reagent. - **aPTT ratio** — patient time divided by the laboratory's normal control time. Captured by a separate concept set, "aPTT ratio in blood". The two representations are **not interconvertible** without the laboratory's local normal control. The data dictionary keeps them addressable independently — analyses needing a homogeneous variable should pick one representation rather than merging across. ## Included Concepts The set is an explicit list of three LOINC "Lab Test" concepts, without descendants. (LOINC 2.82 remodelled its coagulation terms (the component became the generic "Coagulation", the distinguishing part moved to the method axis) and deprecated the LOINC Hierarchy nodes this set used to be anchored on, leaving these tests under "Lab terms not yet categorized"; LOINC offers no replacement grouping.) **Platelet poor plasma**: - *3018677 / 14979-9 — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay*: the standard hospital lab measurement. Most widely used LOINC code worldwide. - *3041232 / 52123-7 — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --post heparin neutralization*: clinically equivalent to a standard aPTT — produced when a heparinised sample is treated with polybrene/heparinase before measurement. **Whole blood**: - *3013466 / 3173-2 — aPTT in Blood by Coagulation assay*: aPTT measured on whole blood (rare; some point-of-care devices). Not to be confused with the activated clotting time (ACT), which is a distinct point-of-care test. **Note on units.** Recommended unit follows LOINC's `EXAMPLE_UCUM_UNITS`: **`s`** (concept 8555 — second) for all three codes. Source systems may report aPTT in `s` or `sec`; conversion is identity. ## Excluded Concepts The following LOINC concepts are deliberately not part of this set: **aPTT ratio**: - *40766287 / 63561-5 — aPTT actual/normal in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay*: dimensionless ratio (patient/normal control). Captured by the separate concept set "aPTT ratio in blood". **Sequential specimen series (3 codes)** — successive aPTT measurements on a series of timed specimens during a thrombolysis or anticoagulation protocol (research/protocol context): - *3004144 / 13058-3* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --2nd specimen - *3007328 / 13059-1* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --3rd specimen - *3008791 / 13060-9* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --4th specimen **Pharmacokinetic challenge series (13 codes)** — aPTT measured at fixed timepoints relative to a pharmacological challenge: - *3039283 / 40099-4* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --2 hours pre XXX challenge - *3042436 / 40100-0* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --baseline - *3038425 / 40101-8* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --30 minutes post XXX challenge - *3038547 / 40102-6* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --1 hour post XXX challenge - *3040681 / 40103-4* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --1.5 hours post XXX challenge - *3042294 / 40104-2* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --2 hours post XXX challenge - *3040598 / 40105-9* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --3 hours post XXX challenge - *3040750 / 40106-7* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --4 hours post XXX challenge - *3040623 / 40107-5* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --6 hours post XXX challenge - *3040743 / 40108-3* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --8 hours post XXX challenge - *3042449 / 40109-1* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --12 hours post XXX challenge - *3038668 / 40110-9* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --1 day post XXX challenge - *3042634 / 40111-7* — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --18 hours post XXX challenge **1:1 saline mixing studies (2 codes)** — patient plasma diluted 1:1 with saline to investigate the cause of a prolonged aPTT: - *3016529 / 16631-4* — aPTT saline 1:1 in Blood by Coagulation assay - *3045961 / 43734-3* — aPTT saline 1:1 in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay **Activated protein C (APC) resistance variant**: - *3052968 / 48590-4 — aPTT after addition of APC in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay*: APC resistance test (factor V Leiden screen). Different clinical question, belongs to a thrombophilia-screening concept set. **Protein C activator panels (2 codes)**: - *3041974 / 52766-3 — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay -- after addition of protein C activator + Factor V depleted plasma/aPTT* — aPTT --after addition of protein C activator + Factor V depleted plasma/aPTT - *3041944 / 52767-1* — Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay -- after addition of protein C activator/Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) The set also deliberately omits: - **Control / Pool / Fetus specimens**: laboratory QC data or out-of-scope specimens. - **Lupus-sensitive aPTT** variants: research/specialised assays for antiphospholipid syndrome workup. - **CRRT / circuit-blood specimens**: specialised monitoring, out of scope for routine aPTT. ## Mapping Notes - **Default concept** when the source reports "aPTT", "APTT", "PTT" in seconds without further specification: `3018677 / 14979-9 — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay`. By far the most common LOINC code (routine hospital lab on citrated plasma). - **Source reports an aPTT ratio** (patient/control, dimensionless): do **not** map to aPTT. The aPTT ratio has its own concept set, "aPTT ratio in blood". - **Whole-blood aPTT** (rare): map to `3013466 / 3173-2 — aPTT in Blood by Coagulation assay`. Note: this is **not** the activated clotting time (ACT) — ACT is a different point-of-care test with its own LOINC code. - **Heparinised sample treated for aPTT measurement**: map to `3041232 / 52123-7 — aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --post heparin neutralization`. - **Do not confuse with**: prothrombin time (separate concept set), activated clotting time (ACT), APC resistance test, thrombin time, or anti-Xa heparin level. ## References [1] Langdell RD, Wagner RH, Brinkhous KM. Effect of antihemophilic factor on one-stage clotting tests; a presumptive test for hemophilia and a simple one-stage antihemophilic factor assay procedure. *J Lab Clin Med*. 1953;41(4):637-47. [2] Nomenclature for Properties and Units (NPU). IFCC/IUPAC. NPU codes (current release). Available: https://npu-terminology.org/npu-database/

versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). LOINC 2.82 remodelled its coagulation terms and deprecated the LOINC Hierarchy nodes the set was anchored on, leaving every test under 'Lab terms not yet categorized' with no replacement grouping (confirmed in LOINC 2.83). The expression is now an explicit list of the same LOINC concepts, without descendants; the exclusions it needed are dropped. Resolved concepts are unchanged. 1 concept name updated by the vocabulary (e.g. 'aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay --post heparin neutralization' -> 'aPTT post heparin neutralization in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay').
